content.comment_body: I'm facing a limitation with the [product_name] regarding sending multiple text messages, even though it's updated to the latest firmware. The module restricts TEXT messages to a maximum of 20, and while it works well for SMS, this isn't enough to cover my complete [product_name] system. My setup consists of a master and slave configuration using relay and input modules, fully utilizing all digital inputs and outputs for building status and alarm systems. Since I’d like to monitor ON/OFF status for each channel, the 20-message limit only covers half my needs. Is there an efficient way to send just one message per event and include current status (like time or data) in the message, possibly reducing the total messages required? Any practical example or advice to address this is appreciated.

Hello, It seems you have two choices: you can either reduce the number of signals to fit within the message cap, or you could add another [product_name] module to give you an additional set of 20 messages. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: The user encounters a restriction on the number of unique text messages that can be sent by the [product_name] module, limiting system monitoring capabilities in building automation. Monitoring ON/OFF status for multiple channels effectively doubles the messaging needs, intensifying the constraint.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes for the [product_name] to support more than 20 separate text message alerts, enabling comprehensive coverage of all signal states (including ON/OFF status) being monitored.
